A.text: Clinicians are advised to use their expertise to camouflage the syringe for children and adolescents.

B.text: The advice is to camouflage the syringe, which is the opposite of leaving it in full view.

cites.section: RECOMMENDATIONS: CLINICAL PRACTICE GUIDELINE › Children undergoing**

C.text: The advice applies to both children and adolescents, not to adolescents alone.

cites.section: RECOMMENDATIONS: CLINICAL PRACTICE GUIDELINE › Children undergoing**

D.text: Camouflaging the syringe is the recommended practice, so saying it is not recommended is wrong.

cites.section: RECOMMENDATIONS: CLINICAL PRACTICE GUIDELINE › Children undergoing**

explanation.text: The recommendation is for clinicians to camouflage the syringe during local anesthesia delivery to children and adolescents.
